title: Oswald infiltrates Free Cuba group and is arrested in New Orleans

tellings.quote: He he infiltrated the group. That was when he got arrested on the street, remember?

plain: In 1963 in New Orleans, Lee Harvey Oswald worked his way into an anti-Castro 'Free Cuba' group, and that was when he was arrested on the street. A researcher named Dan Sheehan tells Michels this as something already known, without naming a source. In his telling Oswald was acting as an infiltrator, not simply a lone man.
